scope: Tracked source/configuration files in the main repository. Focused means only the named paths/functions were inspected, never a claim that every line was reviewed.
limits: Gitlink/vendor repositories, generated artifacts, binary dependencies and device-only behavior are outside this tracked-file inventory. No iPhone/Mac simulator/Instruments access in this Windows workspace.

focused.Tests/ArchiveLock/migration.py: New fault-injection test for the production legacy cleanup branch.
focused.Tests/MenuPresentation/run.py: Extended production localization and VLESS feedback tests.
focused.Tests/NetworkRecovery/run.py: Production EOF fixtures and new rejected-size-event cases.

focused.submodules/ChatListUI/Sources/ArchiveLoc: Password prompt, persistence callbacks, alert presentation and migration resolution.
Archive string table and app-language fallback.

focused.submodules/ItemListUI/Sources/ItemListIt: Presentation data and layout protocol definitions.
focused.submodules/ItemListUI/Sources/Items/Item: Layout insets, font/cursor updates and text input callbacks.

focused.submodules/SettingsUI/Sources/ArchiveSet: Password switch, callbacks and legacy credential cleanup.

focused.submodules/SettingsUI/Sources/ForkExtras: Native presentation, language table/resolver and selected settings rows; not all feature actions.
focused.submodules/SettingsUI/Sources/MessageSav: Read complete file; store snapshot, attachment affordance, presentation and refresh chain.

archiveIsPasswordProtected and notification redaction entry point; not entire file.
